text:
elaine-k: Heads-up — candidate (Jae Song) for Senior Backend Eng pinged: childcare backup fell through, ETA now 12:40 for a 09:30-16:30 onsite loop. He asked if we can compress interviews and whether a private quiet nook exists for pumping.

sam-w: Which sessions are must-be-in-person? I own the 14:00 system pairing and the 15:15 culture chat. The pairing really benefits from onsite network access but can be shortened.

recruiter-bot: Candidate profile: Jae Song, needs lactation/pumping-compatible quiet space, dietary: vegetarian, contact jae.s@example.com. Prefers compressed afternoon if possible.

elaine-k: Plan: 1) create backup Meet link for morning slots 2) reserve Wellness Room H 12:00-17:00 as private nook 3) compress technical blocks into 13:00-15:30 with on-site pairing at 14:00 (shortened to 50m) 4) prepaid rideshare up to $60 if he misses transit. @frontdesk-bot can you prereg and prep vegetarian lunch? @it-ops-bot hotspot + pairing VM?

frontdesk-bot: Visitor pre-registration completed for "Jae Song". Vegetarian boxed lunch ordered and labeled. Wellness Room H reserved 12:00-17:00. Parking permit emailed to candidate.

it-ops-bot: Pairing VM (redwood-pair-04) reserved and wired into Lab Network. Loaner mobile hotspot HS-77 prepped at IT desk.

elaine-k: Panel ask: please add backup Meet to invites and be ready to compress/merge where possible. Sam — can you shorten pairing to 50m at 14:00 and be prepared to accept a remote-perf fallback if candidate arrives late?

sam-w: I can cut the pairing to 50m and accept remote fallback. I'll bring a short checklist for the 15m debrief so we stay on time.

recruiter-bot: Candidate message queued (posting for transparency):

```
Hi Jae — sorry about the childcare issue. We can run your morning interviews remotely if needed; backup Meet: https://meet.google.com/jae-backup. We've reserved Wellness Room H for a private quiet nook (12:00-17:00) and will provide a vegetarian lunch. We can compress the technical blocks into an afternoon window and keep pairing at 14:00 (shortened). If you miss transit we can cover a rideshare up to $60 (send receipts to hr@redwood.ai). Please confirm preference.
```

recruiter-bot: Message sent at 08:05 — candidate replied at 08:40: "Thanks — please compress to afternoon, I'll aim for 12:40 and appreciate the private space."

frontdesk-bot: Badge printed and on-hold for "Jae Song". Wellness Room H will have a low table and chair with power strip. Vegetarian boxed lunch at reception.

elaine-k: Update at 11:50 — candidate running slightly behind, expected 12:50. We'll run morning slots remote, start compressed block at 13:00, pairing 14:00 (50m) in-person. Sam, please confirm you're set for 13:00 start.

sam-w: Confirmed — I'll start at 13:00 and be onsite for the pairing.

it-ops-bot: Hotspot HS-77 checked out on candidate arrival. Pairing VM ready in Lab Network.

frontdesk-bot: Candidate checked in at 12:48 and is in Wellness Room H prepping.

elaine-k: Closing loop — ran morning interviews remote, compressed afternoon went smoothly, pairing shortened to 50m at 14:00, candidate left at 16:10 for transit and used rideshare offer not needed. Candidate appreciated the private nook and vegetarian lunch. :white_check_mark:
